job_title: Fix dropped frames in live YOLO people counter
text: You mention the model detects fine but the video jumps when it runs on the live RTSP feed. That pattern usually means the camera is being read in the same loop as inference, so the buffer fills and old frames pile up. On a pallet-counting job I fixed exactly this by reading the stream in its own thread that keeps only the newest frame, plus a reconnect on stalls. Throughput went from 14 to 25 fps on one RTX 3060 with no skipping. I can look at your capture loop first (about two hours) and send a fixed version with a short note on what changed. If your model also needs retraining for night footage I can quote that separately. Could you share the stream resolution and the GPU you deploy on?

Both hand over to a person when unsure. For you I would use Twilio, connect your FAQ and test on real past questions. What volume of chats do you get each week? Happy to do a 20-minute call to confirm the scope before you decide anything. I share progress in a short written update every two days and keep the code in a repository you own from the first commit.

job_title: Build sales dashboard from our shop database
text: Five hours each Monday on spreadsheets is the part I would remove. For an online retailer I wrote 14 SQL queries on their Postgres replica and a nightly-refreshed dashboard covering margin per SKU after returns, repeat-purchase cohorts and stock cover. While checking the numbers I spotted a supplier with an 11% return rate against 3% elsewhere, caused by a wrong size chart, worth about $1,900 a month. I would deliver in three weeks with a data dictionary for every metric. Which database holds your orders, and who looks at the report today?

Voice bots feel slow when the reply is generated in full before it is spoken. I cut a phone assistant's time to first audio from 2.9 s to 1.4 s by streaming the reply and speaking after the first sentence. For your web app I would use browser speech capture, streaming transcription and the same sentence-level speech output. A first demo takes about a week. Do you have a preference for the speech provider? I usually work in short milestones with a working demo at each step, so you can stop or change direction early.
